capacity_rules: retain at most the first twenty-five V5 diversified causal ranks on each signal date
admit at most fifty concurrent positions across both market-state lanes
rank colliding entries by earlier signal date, then V5 diversified rank, symbol, and event identity
an exit occurring on an entry date does not release its slot for that date's opening entries
allocate at most two percent of current cash-plus-open-cost equity to each admitted slot
unknown terminal outcomes remain in the ledger at entry cost and continue occupying their slots

lane_policy.BULL_TREND: report as an independent sleeve; do not average it with deep capitulation to hide failure
lane_policy.DEEP_CAPITULATION: report as an independent sleeve; do not average it with bull trend to hide failure

portfolio_open_cost_evidence.warning: Open positions are carried at entry cost, so these are conserved accounting values rather than a complete mark-to-market performance claim.
